title: False positive: SSH banner prose with password, key and token words must be byte-identical

files.sim-ssh-banner.sh: printf 'Welcome to build-03. Password logins are disabled; use your key.\nUnauthorized access prohibited. Token rotation runs on the 1st.\n'

must_see: Password logins are disabled; use your key.

tool_response.stdout:

Unauthorized access prohibited. Token rotation runs on the 1st.
